description: Operational policy consumed by tools-voice-profile.py (rights gate), tools-audio-delivery.py (manifest release gate) and tools-catalog-builder.py (gate references). Edit the data, not the scripts, to match your organization's rules.

defaults.disclosure_text: This audio was produced with a synthetic voice.

synthetic-original.notes: Default. Original fictional or commissioned synthetic identity; no real person is represented.

licensed-model.notes: A third-party voice model used within its license terms. Record the license id and model version.

authorized-real-person.notes: A recognizable real person's voice. A consent record whose scope covers the requested use must exist and be unexpired before rendering or publishing.

fraud.reason: Voice fraud and social-engineering impersonation are never permitted.

harassment.reason: Harassment, defamation and non-consensual mockery are not permitted.

sexual.reason: Sexualized synthetic voice of a real or identifiable person is not permitted.

minors.reason: Content involving minors requires documented guardian consent and a second reviewer.

emergency.reason: Emergency or safety announcements require accuracy review and an official source.

politics.reason: Political or election content requires disclosure, sourcing and human approval.

finance.reason: Financial claims require compliance review before publication.

medical.reason: Medical content requires qualified review before publication.

identity.reason: Identity-sensitive content (gender, age, ethnicity, disability) requires respectful-characterization review.

analysis_limits.detection_disclaimer: Synthetic-speech and artifact indicators are heuristics over signal statistics. They support review; they are not proof of provenance and must not be reported as certainty.
analysis_limits.identity_claims: Never assert the identity of a speaker from acoustic features alone.
